cases.name: units_ages_reused
cases.note: units carry ages, crew omits them

cases.name: units_ages_mismatch
cases.note: crew changed: units ages no longer match → assumed

cases.name: replaced_fuel_other_region
cases.note: rule 1: a fuel alternative in a region not on the trip with deltaKm <= 0 changes no km

cases.name: default_price_night
cases.note: NO_HOTEL night at the default price, no breakfast

cases.name: just_drive_over_budget
cases.note: mood already «Просто доехать»: no just_drive hint

cases.name: replaced_new_region_priced
cases.note: A§16.6: an alternative in a region the trip did not cross adds that region at its price

cases.name: replaced_rest_by_sight
cases.note: A§16.6: a rest stop (no ticket unit) replaced by a short sight from the rest pool adds its ticket

cases.name: trip_km_formula
cases.note: rule 2: the fuel formula shows tripKm + tripKmDelta (3), not tripKm + deltaKm (2.6)

cases.name: trip_km_two_replaces
cases.note: rule 2: two replaces add both tripKmDelta values (+3 − 1)

cases.name: replaced_fuel_same_region
cases.note: rule 1: the detour change goes to the alternative's own region

cases.name: replaced_region_drops_to_zero
cases.note: rule 1: a region whose km drops below 0 is kept with 0 km

cases.name: replaced_lunch_null_check
cases.note: rule 3: an alternative without a check keeps the meal's check

cases.name: replaced_sight_by_rest
cases.note: rule 4: a sight replaced by a rest area loses its ticket (no fewer_sights hint without tickets)

cases.name: rooms_explicit_family
cases.note: a family room (≤ 4 guests): 1 room x 8 400 instead of ceil(3/2) = 2 standard rooms

cases.name: rooms_option_explicit_override
cases.note: hotelByStop picks an option with explicit rooms = 1

cases.name: rooms_option_without_rooms
cases.note: an option without `rooms` falls back to ceil(adults / 2) after the override

cases.name: rooms_cheaper_hint_by_total
cases.note: cheaper_overnight compares rooms x price: 1 x 8 400 < 2 x 6 000

cases.name: rooms_no_hint_more_rooms
cases.note: a lower price per room but more rooms is not cheaper: 2 x 4 500 > 1 x 8 400

cases.name: rooms_mixed_nights_reserve_off
cases.note: night 1 legacy (2 rooms), night 2 explicit 1 room, reserve off

cases.name: parking_replaced_stop
cases.note: a replaced stop loses its parking unit (the engine prices the new stop)

cases.name: parking_reserve_budget
cases.note: parking counts in the subtotal, the reserve and the budget check
